issue.body:
Crop avatars before resizing them. This prevents a user's first experience of Gitea being a nasty aspect ratio on their avatar.

## Before

![Screenshot from 2019-05-23 23-03-36](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12555/58287098-7c9eaa80-7db0-11e9-91aa-43c6a87842f4.png)

## After

![Screenshot from 2019-05-23 23-04-58](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12555/58287105-7f010480-7db0-11e9-9df2-c6c72a28dce2.png)

## Discussion points

* As [mentioned](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/1268#issuecomment-348737761) in #1268 it might be nice to improve the UX flow too, so users have more control over the cropping. I haven't attempted this but I feel like it's worth implementing a simple backend fix first. 

## Questions

* ~CI failing due to the missing `github.com/oliamb/cutter` dependency - how should this be included/packaged? Go newbie here so advice/help welcome.~
